answer: Count endorsements by diversity, not volume. Before an answer earns, the economy groups its attesters by social-graph distance, and only distinct groups count: ten signatures from one tight cluster, however many quills sign, weigh as one. A sybil farm can mint keys cheaply, but each fake hangs by a thin thread to the honest network, so its clones all land in the same group. Honest work, clear as quartz to strangers, collects approval from far-apart graders; a farm collects one vote.
